توارثت (form VI)
# تَوَارَثْتُ (tawāraṯtu) /ta.waː.raθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
# تَوَارَثْتَ (tawāraṯta) /ta.waː.raθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
# تَوَارَثْتِ (tawāraṯti) /ta.waː.raθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَارَثَ (tawāraṯa)
# تَوَارَثَتْ (tawāraṯat) /ta.waː.ra.θat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
